function.name: SearchConnectedServices
function.description: Search for connected services by keywords.

keywords.description: The search keywords to match against service names and descriptions.

max_results.description: The maximum number of results to return.

function.name: SearchTriggers
function.description: Search for triggers in a specific connected service by keywords.

service_name.description: The name of the connected service to search in.

keywords.description: The search keywords to match against trigger names and descriptions.

max_results.description: The maximum number of results to return.

function.name: SearchActions
function.description: Search for actions in a specific connected service by keywords.

service_name.description: The name of the connected service to search in.

keywords.description: The search keywords to match against action names and descriptions.

max_results.description: The maximum number of results to return.

function.name: CreateApplet
function.description: Create a new applet with specified trigger and action.

trigger_service_name.description: The name of the service containing the trigger.

trigger_name.description: The name of the trigger to use.

trigger_parameters.description: The parameters for the trigger as a JSON string.

action_service_name.description: The name of the service containing the action.

action_name.description: The name of the action to use.

action_parameters.description: The parameters for the action as a JSON string.

function.name: SearchApplets
function.description: Search for applets by trigger and action keywords.

trigger_keywords.description: Optional keywords to match against trigger service and name.

action_keywords.description: Optional keywords to match against action service and name.

max_results.description: The maximum number of results to return.

function.name: UpdateApplet
function.description: Update an existing applet with new trigger and action configuration.

applet_id.description: The ID of the applet to update.

trigger_service_name.description: The name of the service containing the trigger.

trigger_name.description: The name of the trigger to use.

trigger_parameters.description: The parameters for the trigger as a JSON string.

action_service_name.description: The name of the service containing the action.

action_name.description: The name of the action to use.

action_parameters.description: The parameters for the action as a JSON string.

function.name: DeleteApplets
function.description: Delete one or more applets by their IDs.

applet_ids.description: A single applet ID or a list of applet IDs to delete.
